data.ruling: The stock verifier's refutation holds, so the refutation stands. INA228AIDGSR fails sourcing rule 4 at JLCPCB. The exact LCSC match C2887910 reads stockCount 0 and canPresaleNumber -236. The need is 5 boards (S7) x 2 placements (IOBoard.md:74, :112, :465 and :503, one INA228 for each shunt path) = 10. S4 sets the gate at 5 x 10 = 50, never under 50, so the gate is 50, and 0 is under it. Rule 4 also fails any negative presale count, whatever the stock says. The part is not held: neither the Held parts table nor inventory-2026-09-25.csv has an INA2xx row, so rule 6 does not apply. The rule 5 second-vendor route fails as well. Digi-Key reads 0 in all three packagings, with a manufacturer lead time of 20 weeks. The datasheet verifier confirmed every check and refuted nothing. The stock verifier's other checks pass and are not part of the refutation: lifecycle ACTIVE at TI and Active at Digi-Key, no end-of-life notice, LCSC identity, library type expand, and Texas Instruments is on the S1 allowlist. The owner's answer to V304 (2026-10-02) keeps INA228AIDGSR fixed. It records the unmet gate as a current limitation and gives it to T6 as a stock exception, with the stock read again before the order. Under Scope, Fixed inputs, a fixed input that fails a check is reported to the owner and is not re-selected. V304 therefore does not make rule 4 pass. The refutation stands, the part stays the owner's fixed input, and no replacement candidate goes to new verifiers. Scope is function, because the failure is the rule 4 quantity gate and not one of the part-level causes (lifecycle, end-of-life notice, allowlist, LCSC identity). With stock 0 and a negative presale count, the gate also fails at the 1 placement of External shunt sense input. Earlier adjudicators split on this scope: FU-2B2/015 and FU-2G/010 ruled part, FU-2G/011 ruled function. This ruling agrees with FU-2B2/015 and FU-2G/010 on stands.

It gives status Active, lead_weeks 20, discontinued false, end_of_life false and stock_available 0. Tape & Reel 296-INA228AIDGSRTR-ND has 0, Cut Tape 296-INA228AIDGSRCT-ND has 0 and Digi-Reel 296-INA228AIDGSRDKR-ND has 0. Research.md (checkout 68adf31) states rule 4: "canPresaleNumber zero or above. A negative presale count fails whatever the stock says". S4: "5 times the need of the build being ordered, never under 50". S7: 5 boards. Rule 6 applies only to a held part, and the Held parts table and inventory-2026-09-25.csv carry no INA228. Scope, Fixed inputs: "A fixed input that fails a check is reported to the owner, not re-selected", Motor monitor INA228 (owner, 2026-09-30). V304: "Yes. The unmet stock gate is a current limitation, given to T6 as a stock exception, and the stock is read again before the order (owner, 2026-10-02)". IOBoard.md:465 says "one INA228 for each path", and :112 says "the motor monitors (2 INA228)". Earlier rulings on the same part: round2/FU-2B2/015-adjudicator-R8.json and FU-2G/010-adjudicator-R8.json, both stands true.
